status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Raridon (thigh) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
status.longComment: Raridon started the week as a limited participant Wednesday before downgrading to a non-participant in the Thursday and Friday practice sessions. The rookie third-rounder has still managed to draw the questionable tag despite consecutive absences, meaning the 22-year-old may have been granted some additional rest in anticipation of Sunday's contest.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Patriots placed Onwenu (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.
status.longComment: Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle in the Patriots' win over the Steelers on Sunday, and he appears likely to miss the remainder of the 2026 season. Greg Van Roten is likely the next man up at right guard for New England.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Jones (shoulder) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
status.longComment: Jones was unable to practice throughout Week 3 due to a shoulder injury he suffered in the Patriots' Week 2 win over the Steelers. The outside linebacker's absence means Gabe Jacas will likely start on the edge opposite Elijah Ponder for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Hutchins (knee) was placed on injured reserve Friday.
status.longComment: Hutchins appeared in both of the Patriots' first two games of the 2026 campaign, accumulating three total tackles. The rookie will now miss at least four games while tending to a knee injury. While Hutchins has played sparingly, his absence will still allow Gabe Jacas and Jose Ramirez to see a little more action.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Woodson (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
status.longComment: Woodson was upgraded to a limited participant in Friday's practice after missing the Wednesday and Thursday sessions due to a shoulder injury. The late upgrade in practice participation is a good sign for the starting strong safety, but it remains unclear if one partial practice will be enough to give Woodson the green light to suit up for Sunday's contest.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Patriots placed Pettus (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: Pettus exited the second quarter of Sunday's 20-3 win over the Steelers with an ankle injury, and he'll now have to miss at least the next four games while on IR. With Craig Woodson (shoulder) also injured, the team will likely look to sign or elevate a player from the practice squad  for Sunday's Week 3 matchup against the Jaguars.

status.label: NFI
status.shortComment: The Patriots opened the 21-day practice window for Schooler (back) on Wednesday.
status.longComment: Schooler can now return to practice but won't be eligible to appear in a game until Week 5 due to being on the reserve/non-football injury list. Once officially activated, the 29-year-old should contribute as a depth defender.
